cohort: The cohort included 282 infants born to women who were HPV-positive in both the first and third trimesters.
finding: Vaginal delivery significantly increased the risk of HPV detection in infants compared to caesarean section.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery significantly increased the risk of HPV in infants compared to caesarean section (aOR: 3.63), while infants born after a caesarean with ruptured membranes were not at increased risk compared to those born after an elective caesarean section with intact membranes.
